2610.13627.title: AMLworld-Compact: Importance-Weighted Downsampling for Cost-Effective LLM Evaluation and Error Diagnosis
2610.13627.paper_summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. Sampling reduces this cost, but small balanced subsets change unweighted precision and F1. We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata. Its HT-Coreset protocol reduces evaluation targets by 271x and 611x on HI-Small and LI-Small. Horvitz-Thompson weights give unbiased full-test confusion-count estimates for fixed predictions; recall is exact, while precision and F1 are ratio estimates. In a held-out study using Graph Feature Preprocessor (GFP) features, one boosted-tree family defines strata for evaluating the other over 500 draws per configuration. At the released sizes, F1 RMSE is 0.00-2.58 percentage points versus 4.44-7.41 for uniform sampling with HT weights; conservative intervals remain broad. Under the evaluated graph prompts, seven open-weight LLMs have weighted precision near the predict-all-illicit baseline. In an outcome-stratified audit of 1,000 HI-Small few-shot outputs from one run per model, lexical checks pass for 84.5% of correct and 56.2% of incorrect binary verdicts, so these markers do not establish correctness. We release the evaluation sets, construction code, and audit tools at https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval and https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact.
2610.13627.paper_summary_zh: 評估AMLworld的最小測試分割上的大型語言模型（LLMs）是昂貴的，因為每個超過一百萬的目標都需要一個單獨的圖形提示。<lb/>抽樣可以降低這個成本，但小的平衡子集會改變未加權的精確度和F1。<lb/>我們引入了AMLworld-Compact，一個保留每個非法測試交易並從監督分數層中抽樣良性交易的評估集。<lb/>其HT-Coreset協議在HI-Small和LI-Small上將評估目標減少了271倍和611倍。<lb/>Horvitz-Thompson權重為固定預測提供了無偏的全測試混淆計數估計；召回是精確的，而精確度和F1則是比率估計。<lb/>在使用圖形特徵預處理器（GFP）特徵的保留研究中，一個增強樹族定義了對其他配置進行評估的層，並在每個配置上進行超過500次抽樣。<lb/>在發布的大小下，F1 RMSE為0.00-2.58個百分點，而均勻抽樣與HT權重的情況下為4.44-7.41；保守區間仍然很寬。<lb/>在評估的圖形提示下，七個開放權重的LLMs的加權精確度接近預測所有非法的基準。<lb/>在對每個模型進行一次運行的1,000個HI-Small少量輸出進行的結果分層審計中，詞彙檢查對84.5%的正確和56.2%的不正確二元裁決通過，因此這些標記並未確立正確性。<lb/>我們在https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval和https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact上發布評估集、構建代碼和審計工具。
